title: Gall's law
idea: A complex system that works grew out of a simple system that worked.
apply: Build the smallest version that works end to end, use it, then add one piece at a time.
who: Nia, planning a project tool for her whole company.

scenes.nar: Nia wants a project tool for her company. Her plan has tasks, calendar, chat, reports, billing, and a mobile app, all at once.

scenes.sub: Every part waits on the others.
scenes.nar: Six months later, nothing works end to end. Every part depends on parts that are not finished.
So she restarts small. Version one is only a shared task list, and her team starts using it the next day.
Each new piece lands on something that already works. By week six it even has a calendar view.
